summary: Drug search runs a redundant concept-name full-text query when a concept is specified
description:
Background
In 2.6.x, HibernateConceptDAO.newDrugQuery(...) treated the concept parameter and searchDrugConceptNames as mutually exclusive branches (if / else if): the extra concept-name full-text lookup only ran when no concept was supplied. In 2.8.x the branches are independent, so calling ConceptService.getDrugs(...) with both a concept and searchDrugConceptNames=true always executes an additional Hibernate Search query over the ConceptName index — including its expensive unique-key dedup pass — whose results are redundant because the concept is already known and matched directly.
Requested change
Restore the 2.6.x short-circuit: skip the concept-name full-text lookup when a concept is explicitly provided.
Acceptance criteria
getDrugs with a non-null concept does not execute the concept-name index query, and results are unchanged for all parameter combinations.

Unit tests cover the concept + searchDrugConceptNames=true combination, asserting both result correctness and that the redundant query path is not taken.
